title: Review of c09's active-gel fed comets (SIME): replicates on fresh seed 6 (7 comets swim up to 8.7 BL; starved fork 7 -> 0 by t=130, fed twin keeps 7-10; zeta=0 forms nothing)
summary: Ran world.py, world_starve.py (substrate removed at t=120, identical before) and world_zeta0.py unchanged on seed 6, T=200. From white noise ~50 peaks appear and merge (37 merges); 7 comets of constant ~4.5 px size persist from t~30 (tracks.png), and the top 8 tracks move 3.6-8.7 body lengths (31 long-lived tracks >= 1 BL). Starved fork: 7 comets at t=124, 2 at t=126, 0 at t=130, while the fed twin has 7 at t=130 and 9-10 later (starve_counts_s6.txt). zeta=0: no component ever forms.

observations.S: rerun/world/seed6/sheet.png t=0: white noise over the whole domain
observations.I: rerun/world/seed6/tracks.png: tracks 89, 91, 93, 94 keep a constant ~4.5 px body from t~30-57 to t=200
observations.M: rerun/world/seed6/metrics.json motion_top: tracks 91, 89, 93, 94 move 8.7, 7.5, 7.4, 7.4 BL; 31 long-lived tracks >= 1 BL
observations.E: starve_counts_s6.txt: starved fork 7 -> 0 comets between t=124 and t=130, fed twin 7 -> 9-10

controls_run.E: rerun/world_starve/seed6 (same seed, substrate removed at t=120)
controls_run.M: rerun/world_zeta0/seed6 (no gel flow: no bodies at all)

verdicts.limitation: E holds by construction (the stress generator is made only from substrate and decays), as the claim says. The zeta=0 ablation removes the bodies, not just the motion, so it does not isolate M; a slow-inhibitor RD twin was not run by anyone. Comets are ~4.5 px, near the grid scale (I did not re-run the resolution check). No division; early bodies arise by merging.
